forward_verification.name: the_core_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = '7564fc5c867a11ecc73df9ace925a018' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'health_checks_core_v1'

forward_verification.name: the_inventory_check_judges_controlled_items_only
forward_verification.query: select p.prosrc like '%i.movement_controlled_at is not null and i.last_after is not null%' and p.prosrc like '%where i.qty_on_hand < 0 or%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'health_checks_core_v1'

compatibility.rehearsal: Rehearsed 2026-09-23T03:5xZ on a disposable restore of cascade-supabase-20260923T015850Z (after release money_checks_from_accounting_start_20260923, which this builds on; 0 leftovers). 102 tables, 121 ledger rows; migration applied 1/1; forward 3/3; pgTAP inventory_check_controlled_items_only.sql 4/4, money_checks_from_accounting_start.sql 7/7, verifier_triage_and_opening_amounts.sql 22/22, health_checks_core_v10.sql 26/27 - the one miss is its grant assertion, which a --no-acl restore cannot carry (same as the previous release). Negative control: the same suite against the old body (f54b5cb4) fails test 1, have fail want pass - the production case.
compatibility.evidence: Same function signature, return shape and keys. Only the inventory check's predicate narrows: the movement comparison applies where movement_controlled_at is not null; negative stock is still judged for every item. pgTAP inventory_check_controlled_items_only.sql: silent for the uncontrolled production case, fires and names a controlled item that disagrees, silent when it agrees.
